ns2:section.sectionText: Lectures begin on Monday, June 10, 2019 and discussions begin on Tuesday, June 11, 2019. Hourly examinations will be held on the following Wednesday evenings from 7:00-9:00pm: June 26, July 10, and July 24, 2019. Final exams are scheduled through Aug. 3, 2019. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment.
